text:
Predicates:
SportingEvent(x) ::: x is a sporting event.
OlympicGames(x) ::: x is the Olympic games.
Last(x, y) ::: x is the last y.
Location(x, y) ::: x is located in y.
Country(x, y) ::: x is a country.
Winner(x, y, z) ::: x won the most y in z.
Premises:
∀x (OlympicGames(x) → SportingEvent(x)) ::: The Olympic games is a sporting event.
Last(OlympicGames(last), Tokyo) ::: The last Olympic games was in Tokyo.
Winner(UnitedStates, medals, Tokyo) ::: The United States won the most medals in Tokyo.
Conclusion:
SportingEvent(WorldChampionships) ::: The world championships is a sporting event.
